newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Feb oper deficit at 3.44 pct/gdp - cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Feb oper deficit at 3.44 pct/gdp - cenbank.

text.p: Brazil's public sector operational deficit stood at 3.44 percent of Gross Domestic Product in February, down slightly from 3.68 percent the previous month, the Central Bank said.
The bank said in a statement thsat the operational result, which include debt servicing of the federal government, was a 1.49 percent of GDP deficit versus 1.69 percent in January.

Brazil's states and cities posted a 1.7 percent of GDP deficit in February against 1.77 percent in January and state firms posted a shortfall of 0.26 percent of GDP versus 0.21 percent the prior month.
The Central Bank also said that the public sector net debt stock stood at 276.195 billion reais in February, equal to 34.4 percent of GDP.
In January, net public sector debt was 273.771 billion reais, or 34.5 percent of GDP.
Net internal debt in February was 243.082 billion reais, or 30.2 percent of GDP against 240.9 billion reais, or 30.4 percent of GDP the previous month.
Net external debt in February was 33.113 billion reais, equal to 4.1 percent of GDP. That was slightly up from 32.672 billion reais in January, 4.1 percent of GDP.
